mechanics.name: Visionary
mechanics.currentEffect: Permanently reveals Generator Auras within 32 m. Whenever a Generator is completed, Visionary is temporarily deactivated for 20/18/16 seconds.
activation: Remain within 32 m of a Generator to see its Aura.
Ends/deactivates when: The perk deactivates for 20/18/16 seconds after a Generator is completed.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (unknown): No material live balance change could be verified from available patch history.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: Shows nearby Generator Auras, briefly switching off each time a Generator is completed.
duration: Aura reading resumes after the 20/18/16-second deactivation.
specialInteractions: The deactivation is triggered whenever any Generator is completed.

editorial.summary: Continuously reveal generator Auras within 32 metres, briefly switching off after any generator is completed.
useCases: Find nearby generators on unfamiliar or indoor maps.
Reduce time spent wandering between objectives as a newer player.
Use local generator Auras when map visibility is poor.
counters: Déjà Vu provides stronger macro information and a repair bonus.
The 32-metre range can miss generators on large maps.
The perk deactivates briefly after generator completions.
pros: Always-on local objective guidance outside the short deactivation.
cons: Map knowledge replaces much of the value.
analysis: Visionary ranks this position because finding generators is genuinely useful for newer players, especially on indoor maps where line of sight is poor. A permanent local Aura removes some of the navigation friction that can make early Survivor play frustrating.

The problem is comparison. Déjà Vu shows the strategically important clustered generators and gives a repair-speed bonus on them, while Visionary merely identifies nearby objectives. That makes the latter much harder to justify once both are available.

Experienced players also internalize common generator spawn logic, gradually replacing the perk with game knowledge. The brief deactivation after a generator completes adds another small inconvenience.
Visionary is therefore respectable beginner utility but poor long-term slot efficiency. It does its job clearly; other perks simply do more.
editorial.verdict: A fine training-wheel generator finder that gets outgrown quickly. Visionary helps navigation, but Déjà Vu makes a stronger argument for the same slot.
